_comment: Hand-maintained facts that are not in the plugins. Sources are listed per entry.

notes: Combat trees use stances (Stances NG): Wolf builds bleeding, Hawk builds critical hits, Bear builds armor shred and poise.
Armor perks only need a chest piece of the matching armor type.
Unarmed (Hand to Hand) perks need both hands free.
Alchemy Intensity and Concentration scale in steps every 10 skill levels.
Sneaking costs Stamina based on worn armor; daggers have the highest base sneak attack multiplier.
Running out of Stamina applies an exhaustion debuff for 10 seconds or until half Stamina is back.
The author aimed for about 60-70 perks by level 50, enough to finish roughly five trees.
